body:
Maria Ops: FYI inbound FRA top-off of 24 A100s. Vendor just flagged 2 units as DOA at their QC and proposes split-ship for the rest. AWB: TPX998877. Can we partial-release and push replacements ASAP?
Jordan SCM: Contract replacement window is 7 bd. Vendor offering 36h express for +€3,600. We need to decide: pay for express or pull from loaner pool for shortfall. How critical are the jobs?
Priya (Crossdock): crossdock team: we can stage the good units but we need clear hold tags on the DOA ones or they'll get packed by mistake. Also customs slip references changed on the AWB 12, need vendor to confirm EORI on the replacement AWB.
Liam (VendorLogi): VendorLogi here 1. Confirmed AWB TPX998877 for 22 ship-ready, DOA serials: A100-C1234, A100-C1235. We can dispatch 2 replacements tomorrow via express if approved. Replacement AWB (pending): TPX998877-R. Prepaid RMA label: RX-998877.
Maria Ops: we have a canary cluster using 4 of these. If we hold the 2, SLA risk for canary increases. Recommend partial-release 22 -> staging-FRA, hold 2 at crossdock, approve express for replacements if finance ok.
Jordan SCM: quick inventory check: loaner pool has 1 A100 in AMS and 0 in FRA. Transit >24h from AMS to FRA, not acceptable for canary. Finance approval required for express. Also confirm replacement serials will be pre-configured (vendor says no image flash).
finance-bot: finance-bot: expedited cost (€3,600) < projected penalty and customer credits. Approve up to €4,000. Charge GL: INFRA-GPU-EU. Please attach vendor invoice doc when available.
Liam (VendorLogi): thanks. Scheduling express now. ETA replacement picked up: expected post 1769994680, ETA FRA depot 36-48h, will send final AWB and customs EORI confirmation. RMA return label RX-998877 attached in email.
Priya (Crossdock): acknowledged. Crossdock will apply hold tags: `HOLD-DOA` and move 22 units to `staging-fra-ready`. Please ensure vendor confirms EORI on replacement AWB to avoid customs delays.
Maria Ops: manifest we pushed to staging (snippet):
```
unit,serial,location,status
A100,A100-B1201,staging-fra,ready
A100,A100-B1202,staging-fra,ready
...
A100,A100-C1234,crossdock-fra,hold-doa
A100,A100-C1235,crossdock-fra,hold-doa
```
Maria Ops: tagging done, informing SRE to hold canary roll for 12h to watch stability with reduced capacity. Closing thread unless vendor updates tracking or customs EORI mismatch shows up. (Maria Ops reaction: :white_check_mark:)
